method.name: LayerSettings
method.description: Returns settings of the layer object.

method.name: SetLayerSettings
method.description: Sets settings of the layer object.

method.name: Append
method.description: Append layer of acceptable type (with similar number of priorities or less). Returns false if the list can not be accepted.

method.name: InvalidateBVHData
method.description: Marks BVH tree for given priority list as dirty and marks primitive set for rebuild.

method.name: InvalidateBoundingBox
method.description: Marks cached bounding box as obsolete.

method.name: CullableStructuresBVH
method.description: Returns set of Graphic3d_CStructures structures for building BVH tree.

method.name: CullableTrsfPersStructuresBVH
method.description: Returns set of transform persistent Graphic3d_CStructures for building BVH tree.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
